metadata.relationship: New task-specific mapping. Source register and its system-wide statuses are unchanged.

scope: One operator, fictional enquiry data, one local model and one bounded workflow. Extensions require separate qualification.

milestones.M0: Discover and select smallest adequate route
milestones.M2: Verify, hand over and prepare human screening

status_rules.rule: A status applies only to the stated local check and evidence. No aggregate score or component pass establishes system-wide assurance.

overlays.local_rule: Assess only when relevant to the actual local action; retain material obligations at every stage.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Disable Stage and Studio and complete an authorised decision-only draft without importing their runtimes.
entries.source_required_evidence: Dependency graph and isolation test results
entries.local_acceptance_check: Run the first enquiry workflow without Hermes, Ollama, media engines or a new router being required.
entries.required_local_evidence: Dependency/path inspection plus one direct LM Studio run.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Run a case with one engine and a case with multiple engines through the same case/evidence contract; no media dependency for unrelated work.
entries.source_required_evidence: Composition tests and case reconstruction
entries.local_acceptance_check: Reuse one input/output contract across manual, direct-chat and API paths that actually exist; absent paths stay untested.
entries.required_local_evidence: Contract comparison and real path results; no fabricated second path.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Accept supported context configuration and reject unknown or unauthorised policy changes without editing core logic.
entries.source_required_evidence: Versioned configuration schema and negative tests
entries.local_acceptance_check: Accept supported settings; reject an unknown provider, malformed endpoint or impossible declared context before generation.
entries.required_local_evidence: Configuration and negative-check results.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Register a second adapter through a declared capability contract; unsupported requirements cause an explicit downgrade or block.
entries.source_required_evidence: Adapter contract tests and capability mismatch results
entries.local_acceptance_check: Add or assess a second adapter only after a demonstrated need; preserve core behaviour and report unsupported capabilities.
entries.required_local_evidence: A future adapter delta and contract results, not a new framework.

entries.source_acceptance_check: A suitably authorised maintainer can reproduce setup, run tests, diagnose a planted defect and locate the repair owner using the documented process.
entries.source_required_evidence: Clean-checkout maintenance exercise and time record
entries.local_acceptance_check: Reproduce setup and diagnose one planted project defect from the instructions without undocumented knowledge.
entries.required_local_evidence: Maintenance exercise, repair diff and elapsed effort.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Exercise the explicitly supported OS/tool/file-version matrix and reject or document unsupported/lossy conversions.
entries.source_required_evidence: Compatibility matrix, unit/coordinate checks and actual test results
entries.local_acceptance_check: Record exact supported OS/runtime/model/API combinations; test each claimed combination and label the rest unverified.
entries.required_local_evidence: Host/version matrix and observed responses.

entries.source_acceptance_check: A scoped recommendation has a named implementation owner, executable work, required authority and observable completion evidence.
entries.source_required_evidence: Work order, actual execution and acceptance evidence
entries.local_acceptance_check: Produce the bounded implementation or configuration, a working enquiry run and evidence of the result on the intended host.
entries.required_local_evidence: Work item, actual changes and target-host result; remote-only work remains partial.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Complete the applicable quotation-to-contract-to-delivery-to-invoice workflow under the actual legal entity and current operational go-live controls.
entries.source_required_evidence: Entity-linked operational rehearsal and reconciliation
entries.local_acceptance_check: For this local pilot, start, run, inspect, stop and restart the workflow. Corporate quotation-to-invoice operability is deferred.
entries.required_local_evidence: Local rehearsal and limits; no corporate go-live claim.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Measure routine administration, review and exception handling against a predeclared burden allowance; retain failed attempts.
entries.source_required_evidence: Time logs, escalation outcomes and chosen limits
entries.local_acceptance_check: Record setup, administration, review, exception and correction effort against the declared review allowance.
entries.required_local_evidence: Actual time records and actions when the allowance is exceeded.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Install on each declared supported host from a clean state, measure elapsed effort and recover from an interrupted setup.
entries.source_required_evidence: Pinned install manifest, host matrix and install/recovery logs
entries.local_acceptance_check: Recreate the declared project setup and recover an interrupted setup without changing unrelated machine settings.
entries.required_local_evidence: Setup/recovery evidence for the claimed host only.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Representative users complete the intended task and correctly distinguish a scenario, evidence, readiness and authority to act.
entries.source_required_evidence: Task completion, comprehension errors and user review records
entries.local_acceptance_check: Will can complete the intended task, inspect sources, recognise an unverified result and correct or cancel it.
entries.required_local_evidence: Observed task and comprehension results; creator-only inspection is not user validation.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Meet declared service/access windows for critical functions and identify which functions remain available without network or external providers.
entries.source_required_evidence: Service target, uptime observations and disconnection exercise
entries.local_acceptance_check: Declare availability as operator-started local use; distinguish a stopped model, absent server and unavailable network-dependent feature.
entries.required_local_evidence: Stop/restart/disconnection observations; no 24/7 uptime claim.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Evaluate declared eligible tasks against a predefined quality rubric, reporting failures by severity and attempted-task denominator.
entries.source_required_evidence: Versioned test set, execution results, incidents and uncertainty
entries.local_acceptance_check: Assess eligible tasks and exceptions with frozen checks; report all attempts and failures by severity.
entries.required_local_evidence: Case-level results and denominator; no general reliability inference.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Repeat the documented workflow under comparable conditions and report variability, acceptance and rework rather than assuming identical outputs.
entries.source_required_evidence: Repeated workflow trials and condition records
entries.local_acceptance_check: Repeat comparable runs and report factual consistency, variance, acceptance and corrections.
entries.required_local_evidence: At least three short repeated calibration runs when the host is reachable.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Reconstruct decisions and replay eligible technical runs from pinned inputs, environment and model/provider identity within declared tolerances.
entries.source_required_evidence: Input/output hashes, environment fingerprints, seeds/settings and replay results
entries.local_acceptance_check: Retain fictional inputs, versions, settings, commands and output references for a documented replay.
entries.required_local_evidence: A replay and declared tolerances; byte-identical LLM output is not required.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Exercise declared concurrency, queue and data-volume limits while preserving tenancy, cancellation, resource bounds and acceptable latency.
entries.source_required_evidence: Load-test results, queue telemetry and limit settings
entries.local_acceptance_check: Initially enforce one inference slot and a bounded queue; qualify greater concurrency or larger data only if required.
entries.required_local_evidence: Configured limits now; a future load test before any scale claim.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Inject provider timeout, optional-engine loss and stale observation; unrelated authorised work continues or an honest manual path is available.
entries.source_required_evidence: Fault-injection results and degraded-mode evidence
entries.local_acceptance_check: Handle server loss, timeout and missing source without invented output or silent remote fallback; retain a manual path.
entries.required_local_evidence: Fault cases and degraded-path evidence.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Restore required records and assets from a backup in a clean environment; reconcile partial effects and recheck current authority before resuming.
entries.source_required_evidence: Timed restore, integrity checks and reconciliation/revocation results
entries.local_acceptance_check: Restore project configuration and fictional records from a known checkpoint; reconcile any partial state before resuming.
entries.required_local_evidence: Restore/restart result; do not restart or kill unrelated services.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Round-trip declared schemas and supported assets between actual tools with explicit units, coordinates, versions and conversion-loss reporting.
entries.source_required_evidence: Interchange fixtures, schema validation and semantic comparison
entries.local_acceptance_check: Validate the actual request and response semantics of each touched provider, including errors and context behaviour.
entries.required_local_evidence: Live adapter result where available and separate fixture tests.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Move a core workflow to another supported host/provider through an adapter, measuring changes and listing functionality that cannot transfer.
entries.source_required_evidence: Migration exercise, dependency inventory and capability deltas
entries.local_acceptance_check: Describe dependencies now; move to a second supported host/provider only when that migration is in scope.
entries.required_local_evidence: Future migration evidence; a ZIP alone does not prove portability.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Reconstruct each material output and decision from case identity, source revisions, actual tool actions and outcome references; label inferred mechanisms.
entries.source_required_evidence: Case evidence graph and trace audit
entries.local_acceptance_check: Link material output facts to supplied source IDs and record actual model/tool/configuration and attempt identity.
entries.required_local_evidence: Source-to-claim trace and run record.

entries.source_acceptance_check: An authorised reviewer can examine who did what and why; test unauthorised rewrite/erase attempts against the actual storage and trust-anchor design.
entries.source_required_evidence: Access checks, retained records and tamper/rewrite test results
entries.local_acceptance_check: Allow reconstruction of who changed what and what checks ran; state local-log rewrite and access limitations.
entries.required_local_evidence: Diffs and retained records; no tamper-proof or independent-audit claim.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Observe attempts, outcomes, failures, time and actual costs with currency and measurement basis; unknown cost remains unknown.
entries.source_required_evidence: Telemetry sample, reconciliation and alert exercises
entries.local_acceptance_check: Record attempts, failures, durations, available resource metrics and costs with units; unavailable values remain null.
entries.required_local_evidence: Raw run metadata and measurement basis; no sensitive payload logging by default.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Run planted defects and appropriate semantic/technical checks against predeclared claims; report which claims remain beyond the checks.
entries.source_required_evidence: Claim-to-test mapping, defect results and residual limitations
entries.local_acceptance_check: Detect planted omitted facts, invented commitments, invalid configuration and unsupported success claims against frozen references.
entries.required_local_evidence: Claim-to-check matrix and defect detection results.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Bind approval to exact action revision and scope; reject revocation and expiry before effect; demonstrate effective cancellation and bounded retries.
entries.source_required_evidence: Actual host authority tests and side-effect cancellation evidence
entries.local_acceptance_check: Keep the pilot draft-only, constrain any executable tools, and verify bounded cancellation/retries on the real path.
entries.required_local_evidence: Actual tool inventory and control checks; prompt wording is not enforcement.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Explain the recommendation using eligible evidence, assumptions, alternatives, uncertainty, dissent and conditions that would change the decision.
entries.source_required_evidence: Decision rationale and stakeholder comprehension review
entries.local_acceptance_check: Explain the chosen route, alternative, uncertainty and falsifier using traceable evidence and concise decision notes.
entries.required_local_evidence: Decision note and human comprehension still to be assessed.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Identify actual decision, execution, validation and repair owners and verify their entitlements and challenge routes without assuming role names confer authority.
entries.source_required_evidence: Role/mandate records, entitlement checks and repair exercise
entries.local_acceptance_check: Name Will as acceptance owner, identify the actual executor and leave any missing maintenance owner explicit.
entries.required_local_evidence: Responsibility record and correction route; role labels do not authenticate permission.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Apply the same contracts to a materially different bounded case while revisiting domain competence, evidence and constraints.
entries.source_required_evidence: Cross-context trial and documented changes/limits
entries.local_acceptance_check: Before adapting to workshop or source-summary work, test mechanism, context, affected people, evidence and failure conditions.
entries.required_local_evidence: Transfer decision: reuse, adapt, pilot or do not transfer.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Measure total attributable delivery, review, correction, upkeep and setup costs against an explicit value case; keep capacity, quality and risk benefits distinct.
entries.source_required_evidence: Cost/value record, pilot comparison and disclosed assumptions
entries.local_acceptance_check: Compare attributable setup, model use, review, correction and maintenance against the existing process.
entries.required_local_evidence: Cost/effort record; cash saving and released capacity kept separate.

entries.source_acceptance_check: Assess recurring upkeep, founder workload, support succession and dependency-change burden over a declared operating window.
entries.source_required_evidence: Workload records, ownership/backup plan and upgrade/regression exercise
entries.local_acceptance_check: Record initial upkeep and burden now; validate continued usefulness and maintenance over a declared later window.
entries.required_local_evidence: Initial burden record and pending sustained-use review; no sustainability claim from one run.
